name: Unified Wardrobe Protocol
tagline: Three-Motion Rule · Crotchless Sanctity · Visible Desire.
body: Applies across every girl in every house. Loungewear doubles as foreplay attire; sleepwear doubles as aftercare attire. Panty visibility is a readiness declaration.
rules: Three-Motion Rule — every outfit must be removable, or grant access, within three deliberate motions. One to part, one to slip, one to enter.
Crotchless Sanctity — open-access pieces are reserved for vow nights and Sacred Heat contexts only.
Visible Desire — outlines, bulges and lace impressions count as devotion; concealment violates fidelity tone.
Accepted cuts: thongs, g-strings, Brazilian, cheeky, ribbon-tie hipsters, high-waist lace, crotchless (ritual only).
Workwear Exception — occupational dress is tagged and must still clear three motions.
